_comment: CROSS-MODEL SETTLING TIME COMPARISON — designed 2026-09-03, not yet launched
_purpose: Test whether settling time is universal (all architectures), recurrence-specific (SSM/hybrid only), or Falcon-specific. Three models, same task, same observables.

_design.key_question: Is settling time a property of recurrent computation, or all neural computation?
_design.prediction_if_recurrence_specific: Pure transformer shows NO settling (peak at s0 for all depths). Pure SSM shows settling similar to hybrid.
_design.prediction_if_universal: All three architectures show settling, possibly with different s*(d) curves.
_design.prediction_if_falcon_specific: Neither pure SSM nor pure transformer shows settling. Would indicate architecture-specific interaction effect.
_design.falsification: Any model with settling at d>=2 (peak suffix > s0 with gain > 10%) confirms settling is not Falcon-specific.

models.label: pure_ssm
models.architecture: Pure Mamba SSM, no attention layers
models.notes: Base model, not instruction-tuned. May fail competence on Python scoping. Failure is informative.

models.label: pure_transformer
models.architecture: Pure transformer, standard attention, no SSM/recurrence
models.notes: Base model. Strong code training (36T tokens). Should pass competence. Key control: if no settling, recurrence is required.

models.label: hybrid
models.notes: ALREADY TESTED in SVB-0/SVB-1. Reuse existing data. Only rerun if needed for direct comparison under identical conditions.

_runner_adaptation_needed.mamba_cache: run_svb_0.py uses copy.deepcopy(out.past_key_values) which should work with MambaCache. Verify that MambaCache supports the past_key_values kwarg on forward(). If not, need a thin adapter layer.
_runner_adaptation_needed.base_model_prompting: Base models (not instruction-tuned) may need different prompting — no chat template, just raw code. Current templates are raw Python which should work for base models.
_runner_adaptation_needed.model_loading: Mamba models require mamba-ssm and causal-conv1d packages. Verify installed.

_execution_plan.phase_1: Run pure_transformer (Qwen3-1.7B) first — no special dependencies, DynamicCache works. ~30 min CPU for depths 1-2.
_execution_plan.phase_2: Run pure_ssm (Mamba-1.4b) — requires mamba-ssm package. Test deepcopy of MambaCache first. ~30 min CPU.
_execution_plan.phase_3: Compare all three. If both new models pass competence, compare settling profiles.
